about_the_game:
Keyboard Wizards

Type. Cast. Conquer!


Keyboard Wizards is a fast-paced, magic-infused card battler where every spell is cast by your typing skill! Build your spell deck, unleash powerful magic, and test your reflexes in battles inspired by Philippine folklore.

🧙‍♂️ Become the best Keyboard Wizard!


  • Unique Typing Combat: Cast spells and attack enemies by typing magic incantations—speed and accuracy mean victory!

  • Build Your Spell Deck: Collect and customize spell cards, discover powerful combos, and create your winning strategy.

  • Epic Fantasy Battles: Duel deadly AI opponents in magical arenas inspired by creatures and legends from the Philippines.

  • Status Effects & Strategy: Heal, Stun, shield, or outwit your foes—timing your typing can mean the difference between victory and defeat!

  • Fantasy Narrative or PvP Combat: Live the story of a new student to SIERRA ENCANTADA INSTITUTE of MAGICAL STUDIES as they rise to become the top wizard—or dominate PvP combat with your typing skills!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or macOS 14 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 / M3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro / M2 / M3
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible sound card
